__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Point this at YOUR OWN Prometheus, scraping YOUR OWN kriyad's /metrics endpoint (operator-only, mTLS or your own network boundary) — inside YOUR boundary. kriya never hosts or sees this data.

title: kriya fleet governance (F3-fleet, doc 28)
description: Aggregate governance KPIs scraped from YOUR OWN kriyad's /metrics endpoint — receipts/day, governed-connector-lane allow/deny/approve counts, per-device coverage completeness, and policy-bundle version spread. kriya remains the only signer in the chain: this dashboard reads already-verified, already-minimized data your own Prometheus scraped from your own kriyad, inside your own boundary. No content, no per-action rows — see docs/TRUST.md's 'Fleet telemetry (F3-fleet)' section for exactly what is and isn't in these numbers.

panels.title: Receipts (fleet total, all time)
panels.description: kriyad_receipts_total — device-reported receipts summed across every accepted envelope ever stored. An aggregate governance count; kriyad never holds per-receipt rows.

panels.title: Devices — current
panels.description: Count of kriyad_device_coverage{status="current"} — devices whose envelope stream is caught up as of the last scrape.

panels.title: Devices — behind
panels.description: Count of kriyad_device_coverage{status="behind"} — a device whose heartbeat claims a higher seq than kriyad has stored yet (a coverage gap in progress).

panels.title: Devices — silent
panels.description: Count of kriyad_device_coverage{status="silent"} — a device unreachable past kriyad's configured silence threshold. Named as an admitted red cell, never hidden (doc 22 §9's 'coverage-completeness' honesty norm).

panels.title: Receipts per day
panels.description: kriyad_receipts_by_day{day=...} — device-reported receipts bucketed by UTC calendar day, from each accepted envelope's own window.to_ms. Capped at the most recent 30 days kriyad reports.

panels.title: Governed-connector-lane decisions (kriya.io.*)
panels.description: kriyad_egress_allow_total / kriyad_egress_deny_total / kriyad_egress_approve_total — counts only, summed across the fleet's accepted envelopes. Never a destination host (doc 24 §4.5's counts-only floor).

panels.title: Device coverage (device id only — no hostnames/usernames)
panels.description: kriyad_device_coverage{device_pub=...,status=...} — one row per known device, labeled by device id (the device's evidence public key) ONLY, per doc 22 §7's GDPR-minimization table.

panels.title: Policy-bundle version spread
panels.description: kriyad_policy_bundle_applied_devices{version=...} — devices currently applying each PolicyBundle version, from each device's own locally-attested policy_state. The fleet's configuration-management baseline (NIST 800-171 CM 3.4.1/3.4.2).

panels.title: Latest published policy-bundle version
panels.description: kriyad_policy_bundle_latest_version — the highest PolicyBundle version ever published to this kriyad. Absent (never a fabricated 0) until an operator has published a first bundle.
